title_en: The Greatest Messenger (peace be upon him and his family) in Umayyad Heritage and Islamic Heritage (Episode 25)
summary: This lecture by His Eminence, the religious authority (marja') Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari continues the examination of the Prophet Muhammad's standing within Umayyad and Islamic historical traditions.
series_en: Debates in Creed - The Greatest Messenger in Islamic Heritage
